title: Altinn Studio - App deploys
description: App deploys and undeploys from Altinn Studio, end to end: the deploy request to Designer, the Azure DevOps pipeline Designer queues and polls, Designer's reconcile call to the runtime gateway, and Flux's install or upgrade result, which the gateway passes back to Designer. Designer marks every deploy's trace to be kept and the trace continues through the pipeline's HelmRelease into the gateway, so most panels join each deploy's spans by trace ID (altinn-studio-traces-logsql, LogsQL) to show it as one row with its outcome and the time each phase took. Flux's results and the hand-off between Designer and the gateways also come from their metrics (altinn-studio-metrics). Filter by the Studio environment that deployed (dev, staging, prod), the environment deployed to and the service owner. Designer's request metrics carry only the Studio environment. Phase times are worked out from the trace: Pipeline is within 10 s of the pipeline's end, since Designer polls every 10 s, and a deploy whose request is outside the time range is left out. The Azure DevOps pipeline sends no telemetry, so its own steps and failure reasons are not here. Datasource UIDs are pinned, matching the other Altinn Studio dashboards.

panels.title: Deploys
panels.description: Deploy requests to Designer (POST .../deployments) in the time range, from their server spans. Designer marks every deploy request's trace to be kept, so the count is complete.

panels.title: Failed requests

panels.title: Hand-off between Designer and the runtime
Flux results not passed on to Designer
panels.description: Flux results the runtime gateway could not pass on to the Studio environment that deployed the app, by error.type: helm_release_unresolved when the HelmRelease lacks the labels that name the app and build, otherwise the HTTP status or exception from Designer. targets.expr: sum by ("error.type") (increase_pure({"altinn.gateway.deploy_events", "service.name"="gateway", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner", "altinn.gateway.origin_environment"=~"$studio_env", "error.type"!=""}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Reconcile requests by status code
panels.description: Designer's requests to the runtime gateways to reconcile an app's Flux resources after a pipeline succeeded, by the gateway's response status. Not filtered by Studio environment.

targets.expr: sum by ("http.response.status_code") (increase_pure({"http.server.request.duration_count", "service.name"="gateway", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner", "http.route"="/runtime/gateway/api/v1/deploy/apps/{app}/{originEnvironment}/reconcile"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Designer's deploy routes by status code
panels.description: Designer's responses on its deploy routes: deploy (POST .../deployments), undeploy, the deploy list and Flux results from the gateways (.../deployments/webhooks/events). A 404 on webhooks/events is an uninstall with no pending undeploy in Designer. Designer's request metrics have no service owner or environment deployed to, so only the Studio environment filter applies.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by ("http.request.method", "http.route", "http.response.status_code") (increase_pure({"http.server.request.duration_count", "service.name"="studio-designer", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$studio_env", "http.route"=~".+/deployments(/undeploy|/webhooks/events)?"}[$__interval])), "route", "$1", "http.route", ".*/(deployments.*)")
